mapper.select: SELECT pmc.id AS methodId, cc.code AS methodCode, pmc.name AS methodName, ma.url AS imageUrl, pmc.description AS description, pmc.active AS active, pmc.sort_no AS sortNo FROM pay_method_cfg pmc JOIN common_code cc ON pmc.method_id = cc.id JOIN media_asset ma ON pmc.image_asset_id = ma.id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay_method_cfg WHERE id = #{methodId}
